name: Phayao Kingdom
native: เมืองพะเยา (Mueang Phayao)

predecessors.name: Ngoenyang
predecessors.text: the throne of Phukamyao, which Chomtham of Ngoenyang took to found a new dynasty at Phayao

successors.name: Lan Na Kingdom
successors.text: Phayao, annexed by Khamfu in 1338 ('Khamfu then annexed Phayao into Lanna')

successors.name: Nan Kingdom
successors.text: the eastern cities of Phayao along the upper Yom basin (read as Pong and Chiang Muan, the Yom headwaters in eastern Phayao; the page names no city)

ledger.x: 1094: Phayao separates from Ngoenyang under Chomtham's dynasty.
Bridge at 1261: Mangrai's Ngoenyang annexes Thoeng and Chiang Kham.
1338: Khamfu of Chiang Saen annexes Phayao into Lan Na.
1338: the eastern cities go to Nan.

wars.name: Mangrai's Phayao campaign of 1261
wars.outcome: Mangrai annexed Thoeng and Chiang Kham.

wars.name: Khamfu's annexation of Phayao
wars.outcome: Phayao annexed into Lan Na, its eastern cities into Nan.

certainty.note: A mueang of the Yonok basin; no page gives a frontier.
